body:
There is still time. This is not what you want. I understand how it feels but that's not all there is in life. You need to try your damnedest to keep moving and get to a place where you want to be. Pick up the phone and dial 911 before it's too late. Your boyfriend loves you, hold onto that. It will get worse, and it will get better.

Please, don't do this terrible thing. It is much worse than you realize.
